messages:
Maria (Product): Quick sync — need a concise rollout playbook for the adaptive-fallbacks feature. Scope: feature-flag gating, staged canaries, an A/B branch for fallback behavior, and explicit rollback criteria. Launch target: next Tue. High-level goals: avoid user-visible regressions, clear telemetry, fast rollback paths.

Kevin (Eng): Proposal draft below. Keep it small and automatable. TL;DR: start tiny canary, ramp on stability metrics, run A/B for fallback logic, soft fallback first then hard.

Kevin (Eng): Canary plan:
- Step 0: Feature flag OFF everywhere. Internal QA preview.
- Step 1: Canary 3% for 6 hours (regional: us-west only).
- Step 2: If metrics OK, ramp to 10% for 24h (multi-region: us-west + eu-west).
- Step 3: Ramp to 30% for 48h, then gradual global rollout to 100% if stable.

Kevin (Eng): Example flag config (will live in flags-service):
```yaml
flag: adaptive_fallback
canary:
  initial_pct: 3
  ramp_targets: [10, 30]
  ramp_interval_hours: 24
regions: [us-west, eu-west]
fallback:
  mode: soft  # degrade to smaller model variant, keep response structure
  degrade_to: model-small-quant
  observation_ttl_minutes: 60
rollback_triggers:
  error_rate_pct: 2.0
  p95_latency_ms_increase_pct: 25
  quality_regressions: flagged_by_eval_suite
```

Sam (Infra): Capacity notes — small quant model increases QPS efficiency, but KV cache and memory footprint differ. Need these before step1:
- Warm pool of model-small-quant nodes in us-west (min 10% of canary traffic).
- Autoscale policy: aggressive scaling for canary region for first 48h.
- Pre-provision burst slots to avoid cold-start throttles.

Olivia (SRE): Monitoring & alerts:
- Dashboards: error_rate, p95/p99 latency, token_cost_per_request, model_swap_rate, fallback_rate.
- Canary alert thresholds: error_rate > 1.5x baseline OR p95 latency increase > 20% -> paging.
- Soft-fallback metric: fallback_rate > 5% for >30m -> investigate but don't auto-kill.
- Hard rollback: error_rate delta >= rollback_triggers.error_rate_pct OR catastrophic regression flagged by eval -> auto-disable flag.

James (DevEx): A/B details for fallback evaluation:
- Two cohorts: A = original fallback (current logic), B = adaptive_fallback. Randomize at token-request level with sticky assignment for 24h.
- Metrics: success_rate, p95 latency, tokens_per_response, qualitative sample for hallucination/regression (n=50/day).
- Use existing eval harness to run golden prompt set every 6h against samples from both cohorts.

Kevin (Eng): Rollout cadence notes:
- Ramp windows should be at least 24h after each step to collect stable metrics (except initial 6h smoke).
- If A/B shows better quality but worse cost, we need product signoff (Maria) before full rollout.

Maria (Product): Confirming — cost tradeoffs will require explicit approval. Also want a customer communication plan for enterprise customers in Dedicated/Private.

Sam (Infra): For Dedicated/private customers: we won't auto-enable feature flags. We'll provide the flag config and recommended rollout steps in the private console doc. Add a line in the contract checklist about model variants and KMS access.

Olivia (SRE): Runbook snippet for quick rollback:
1) Flip feature flag to OFF for the affected region(s).
2) If flag service unreachable, use regional kill-switch in infra: `infra kill-switch fallback-all`.
3) Re-route traffic to stable model via routing-policy override.
4) Notify customers and open incident if >5% user-facing errors.

rollout-bot: deploy.canary started: adaptive-fallback v1 -> us-west (3%) [1712507920]. Status: warming nodes. :rocket:

Kevin (Eng): QA checklist before step1:
- Smoke tests pass (end-to-end generation on 10 prompts).
- Telemetry annotated with `cohort` and `canary_tag` on every request.
- Golden eval harness passes baseline with no new hallucination signals.

James (DevEx): Quick note on telemetry: ensure `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `model_variant`, `fallback_reason` fields are present. We need these for cost and quality delta checks.

Maria (Product): Final asks before I approve the rollout doc:
- Add customer comms draft (support + CSM).
- Add explicit decision owner for each ramp (who clicks the next %).
- Confirm who has the kill-switch permission.

Kevin (Eng): I'll author the rollout playbook doc with sections above and assign ramp owners: Kevin -> step1, Sam -> infra escalations, Olivia -> monitoring & thresholds, Maria -> final product signoff. Will ping when doc is ready.

Olivia (SRE): 👍 also adding a smoke-canary that runs synthetic traffic every 5m in the canary region to catch regressions quicker.

Maria (Product): Thanks all — please post the playbook doc link when ready. We want to run QA this Fri and canary next Mon. :calendar:
